name: depot-co
description: Standalone hobby game, NOT a Farming Simulator product. First-person warehouse simulator: receive trucks, put stock away, pick orders, pack them and ship them, then hire a crew and buy a forklift.
author: TheCodingDad-TisonK

scripts.check: node tools/build-game.js --check && node tools/sync-version.js && node tools/lint-gate.js && node --check game/depot.js && node --check game/menu.js && node --check main.js
scripts.installer: npm run check && npm run brand && npm run icon && electron-builder --win nsis --x64 --publish never
